One invention. A whole new spatial layer.

The patent describes an RF perception infrastructure that turns distributed electromagnetic observations into a machine-readable 3D understanding of the world.

01

Distributed perception

Geographically separated RF nodes work together, with overlapping sensing volumes and synchronized observations.

02

Spatial world model

Observations are reconstructed into geometry, occupancy, motion, materials, confidence, uncertainty, and provenance.

03

Adaptive intelligence

The infrastructure can reconfigure sensing resources according to the perception requirement of a place or moment.

04

Privacy-oriented by design

Physical-world understanding can be delivered without relying on conventional optical imagery as the primary representation.

RF perception infrastructure→Spatial world model→Autonomous applications
